title: GSTN e-Invoice JSON Download Facility: Important Maintenance Update for Nov 28-29
content:
# GSTN e-Invoice JSON Download Facility: Important Maintenance Update for Nov 28-29

Ek important update hai. Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN) ne e-Invoice services ke liye scheduled maintenance announce kiya hai.

**Key Details:**

*   **Advisory Date:** November 26, 2026
*   **Maintenance Period:** November 28, 2026 (09:00 AM) se November 29, 2026 (01:00 PM) tak.
*   **Impacted Service:** Is period ke dauran, e-Invoice JSON download functionality (GST portal aur APIs ke through) temporarily unavailable rahegi.
*   **Unaffected Service:** Achhi baat yeh hai ki Invoice Reference Numbers (IRNs) ki generation uninterrupted chalti rahegi.
*   **Reason:** This is due to scheduled maintenance activities.

Taxpayers ko advise kiya ja raha hai ki woh apni e-invoice se related activities ko accordingly plan karein to avoid any inconvenience.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.gst.gov.in/)

*Published on: 28 November 2026*
